description: Root pom.xml updated to add spring-cloud-azure dependency management with version 5.22.0, which is compatible with Spring Boot 3.x
Web module pom.xml updated to replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter and spring-messaging-azure-servicebus dependencies
Worker module pom.xml updated to replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter, spring-messaging-azure-servicebus, and spring-retry dependencies (for retry functionality)
Removed @EnableRabbit annotation and import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.annotation.EnableRabbit, properly cleaning up RabbitMQ-specific configuration
Removed @EnableRabbit annotation and its import, properly cleaning up RabbitMQ-specific configuration

New ServiceBusConfig class created with @EnableAzureMessaging annotation and PropertiesSupplier bean configuration. Sets autoComplete=false for manual acknowledgment, which aligns with the requirement for manual message acknowledgment. The QUEUE_NAME constant properly defines the 'image-processing' queue.

New ServiceBusConfig class created with @EnableAzureMessaging annotation, PropertiesSupplier bean for manual acknowledgment, and RetryTemplate bean configured with SimpleRetryPolicy (MAX_ATTEMPTS=3) and FixedBackOffPolicy (RETRY_DELAY_MS=60000). This properly implements the retry requirements: 3 attempts with 60-second backoff.

Migrated RabbitTemplate to ServiceBusTemplate. Changed from rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(QUEUE_NAME, message) to using MessageBuilder to construct Message<ImageProcessingMessage> and serviceBusTemplate.send(). Updated imports from org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate to com.azure.spring.messaging.servicebus.core.ServiceBusTemplate and added Message/MessageBuilder imports.

Migrated RabbitTemplate to ServiceBusTemplate using the same pattern as AwsS3Service. Constructor updated to accept ServiceBusTemplate instead of RabbitTemplate. Message sending migrated from rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend() to MessageBuilder + serviceBusTemplate.send().

Migrated @RabbitListener to @ServiceBusListener with destination=QUEUE_NAME. Method parameters changed from (ImageProcessingMessage message, Channel channel, @Header(AmqpHeaders.DELIVERY_TAG) long deliveryTag) to (ImageProcessingMessage message, @Header(ServiceBusMessageHeaders.RECEIVED_MESSAGE_CONTEXT) ServiceBusReceivedMessageContext context). Acknowledgment logic updated: channel.basicAck() → context.complete() and channel.basicNack() → context.abandon(). Removed IOException handling and com.rabbitmq.client imports. Added null-check for context before using it.

Migrated @RabbitListener to @ServiceBusListener with destination=QUEUE_NAME. Method parameters changed from (ImageProcessingMessage message, Channel channel, @Header(AmqpHeaders.DELIVERY_TAG) long deliveryTag) to (ImageProcessingMessage message, @Header(ServiceBusMessageHeaders.RECEIVED_MESSAGE_CONTEXT) ServiceBusReceivedMessageContext context). Acknowledgment logic updated: channel.basicAck() → context.complete() and channel.basicNack() → context.abandon(). Renamed retry context parameter from 'context' to 'retryContext' to avoid variable name collision with ServiceBusReceivedMessageContext. Added null-check for context before using it. Removed IOException handling and RabbitMQ imports.

Removed RabbitMQ configuration properties (spring.rabbitmq.host, port, username, password) and replaced with Azure Service Bus configuration (spring.cloud.azure.credential.managed-identity-enabled=true, spring.cloud.azure.servicebus.namespace, spring.cloud.azure.servicebus.entity-type=queue). Properly uses Managed Identity for authentication.
Removed RabbitMQ configuration properties and replaced with identical Azure Service Bus configuration as web module. Uses Managed Identity authentication.
Updated test configuration to use Azure Service Bus properties instead of RabbitMQ properties, ensuring test environment is consistent with production configuration.
